$comment: High and critical npm advisories the CI gate is allowed to pass, with the reason.
An entry is only legitimate while there is genuinely nothing to upgrade to.
scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails if an entry here no longer matches a live advisory,
so an exception cannot outlive the problem it was written for, and fails again
once `review` passes so it cannot quietly become permanent.

why: No patched version exists. The advisory covers braces <= 3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the
latest version published, so every consumer is affected and there is nothing to
upgrade to. npm's suggested fix is a downgrade of webpack-dev-server to 1.14.1
and shx to 0.3.4, which is years of other advisories plus a broken build.
Reached only through devDependencies: shx -> shelljs -> fast-glob -> micromatch,
Nothing here is in the published theme or plugin zip, which contain CSS, a
manifest, a logo and the bundled widget. The reachable attack is a denial of
service from a deeply nested glob pattern, and the only globs these see are the
ones written in this repo's own scripts.
Remove this entry as soon as braces publishes a fix. The gate will tell you:
once the advisory stops matching, this exception is reported as stale and CI
